messages:
olivia: Quick sync — want to lock down the SI trainer exchange week and tie it to the marketplace/hardware onramp timeline. Can folks weigh in on dates and must-haves? :calendar:

devon: I can do the week of May 6. Main ask: hands-on lab access for each SI (1 GPU node per pair) + a pre-configured image.

liam: Agree on infra. Hardware partners also want a short onboarding lab for their cards (30m demo + 1h hands-on). We should include them on day 2.

sasha: Certification angle: recommend a two-tier cert — "Integrator Ready" (practical lab + short eval) and "Partner Trainer" (train-the-trainer + checklist). Need rubric.

jen: Marketing heads up — if we want a joint announcement with marketplace listing, deadline for PR assets is May 1. That means the partner coop materials need to be finalized by Apr 28.

olivia: Good call. So timeline constraints: PR assets by May 1, training week May 6, partner lab day May 7. Any blockers from eng/onboarding?

devon: Onboarding team needs 2 weeks to bake the images and infra scripts. So target build freeze Apr 22. Also need sample app repo + eval prompts.

liam: Hardware partner (NimbleCompute) confirmed loaner units for demos but shipping ETA Apr 24. That fits if we freeze earlier.

sasha: For the cert rubric draft, propose these components:
```
- Practical: deploy Redwood Private demo, run 3 inference scenarios (latency/cost targets)
- Troubleshooting: simulate a failed KV cache warmup
- Teaching: deliver 15m mini-training to peers
```
We can auto-grade practical steps where possible.

jen: I'll start a PR asset checklist: partner logos, joint blog draft, one-pager, quotes, hero screenshot. Can we get the hero screenshot from console staging by Apr 25? @marketplace-bot any ETA on staging access for partners?

marketplace-bot: Staging listings are available. API keys will be created on Apr 18. See https://staging.marketplace.redwood.example/listings

olivia: Nice. Quick decisions: 1) freeze build Apr 22 2) PR assets due Apr 28 3) training week May 6-10 with hw lab day May 7 4) cert rubric v1 Apr 20. Everyone ok?

devon: Ok from onboarding. I'll schedule image build sprints Apr 10-22.

liam: I'll confirm hardware logistics and a partner contact list by Apr 12.

sasha: I'll push cert rubric v1 by Apr 20 and a short grading script for the practical steps.

jen: I'll own PR draft and coordinate partner quotes. Will tag design for hero screenshots Apr 23.

olivia: Thanks — I'll put together a one-page runbook and an internal intake form for partner trainer nominations. If anyone wants to add blockers, drop them here. :thumbsup:

liam: One thought — can we include a small stipend for trainer travel? Partners asked. Budget owner?

devon: Finance needs a proposed line item. I can sketch numbers if you want.

olivia: Yes please, devon — a rough estimate by Apr 15. That should feed the ops request.

sasha: Also propose a lightweight "seal" graphic for certified trainers we can include in marketplace listings. I'll mock one after rubric v1.

jen: Noted. Will add "seal" to PR assets list.

olivia: Great. I'll update this thread with the runbook link shortly and create calendar invites. Thanks team.
